summary: Playwright domcontentloaded waits timed out at 25s for every probed route (J-01 through J-09) because the dev server's webpack compile is poisoned by the action-inbox-actions.ts Server Actions contract violation (UX-BUILD-001). The poisoning cascades through the entire src/app/** module graph. The browser harness therefore produced zero usable page renders and zero screenshots; this file is the proof of the EVIDENCE_BLOCKED state. Decisive evidence for UX-BUILD-001 itself is captured in build-failure-log.txt (bun run build exit 1) and dev-server-runtime-log.txt (HTTP 500 responses for /workshop, /admin, /admin/today, /privacy, /security, /access-required).

network_failures_summary.interpretation: The timeouts are not network failures in the usual sense; they are compile failures served over HTTP. Every route's webpack bundle compilation fails because the action-inbox-actions.ts module is unparseable as a 'use server' module. This is the runtime signature of UX-BUILD-001.

screenshots_blocked_reason: Every page.goto timed out before DOMContentLoaded; page.screenshot therefore had no rendered content to capture.
interpretation_for_plan_pack: Browser evidence could not be collected at HEAD. Once UNIT-001 (UX-BUILD-001) is implemented, a re-audit pass should re-run /tmp/ux-audit.mjs and advance the source-traced (CURRENT_SOURCE_CONFIRMED / CALL_FLOW_CONFIRMED) findings to BROWSER_CONFIRMED where the live behavior matches the source claim.
